#docs
## Path parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `biz` | `string` | **yes** | Business id (biz_…) |
| `sub` | `string` | **yes** | Subscription id (sub_…) |

## Headers

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `Idempotency-Key` | `string` | no | Safely retry writes — repeats return the original response. If a write FAILED after it had already taken effect, that failure is what repeats: the key is spent, and a new attempt needs a new key. |

## Body

The request body is **required**.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `type` | `string` | **yes** | The kind of change to schedule. One of `cancel`, `pause`, `resume`, `change`. |
| `effective_at` | `string · ISO-8601` | **yes** | When the change takes effect (ISO-8601 UTC). |
| `changes` | `array of object` | no | Existing items to change. |
| `adds` | `array of object` | no | Items to add. |
| `removes` | `array of string` | no | Ids of the subscription items to remove (si_…). |

## Response

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `object` | `string` | The object type; always `scheduled_change`. One of `scheduled_change`. |
| `id` | `string` | The scheduled change id. |
| `type` | `string` | What the change does. One of `cancel`, `pause`, `resume`, `change`. |
| `effective_at` | `string · ISO-8601` | When the change runs. |
| `payload` | `object` | The change details. |
| `status` | `string` | The state of the change. One of `scheduled`, `applied`, `canceled`, `failed`. |
| `applied_at` | `string · ISO-8601` | When the change ran. |
| `attempts` | `integer` | Number of times the change was tried. |
| `last_error` | `string` | Why the last try failed. On an applied change, why nothing moved. |
| `failed_at` | `string · ISO-8601` | When the change gave up. |
| `created_at` | `string · ISO-8601` | When the change was scheduled. |

## Status codes

| Status | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `201` | Scheduled |
| `404` | No such subscription |
| `409` | Idempotency-Key conflict — the key is already in flight, or was reused with a different request payload. |

#request
```bash [Request]
curl -X POST "$TMBILLING_URL/v1/businesses/biz_XXXXXXXXXXXX01/subscriptions/sub_XXXXXXXXXXXX01/schedule" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TMBILLING_API_KEY" \
  -H "Idempotency-Key: $(uuidgen)" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "type": "cancel",
    "effective_at": "2026-03-14T09:30:00Z"
  }'
```
